name: Alpha Invariance Initialization
definition: A method to initialize the density-predicting network such that the average volume transmittance $T'$ is high (e.g., 0.99) regardless of scene scale $L$, preventing opaque initial scenes and optimization failure due to floaters.
summary: Alpha Invariance Initialization sets high average transmittance regardless of scene scale, distinguishing itself by providing a theoretical foundation for density initialization rather than relying on heuristic steps.
